function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

message.content: 2015 年的國際象棋世界錦標賽（World Chess Championship 2015）由 **馬格努斯·卡爾森（Magnus Carlsen）** 贏得。
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？" This is Chinese: "Who won the 2015 International Chess Championship?" They likely refer to the World Chess Championship 2015. That was held in 2015, and the winner was Magnus Carlsen. But let's confirm: The 2015 World Chess Championship was between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin. Carlsen won. So answer: Magnus Carlsen.

But maybe they refer to "2015 International Chess Championship" could be something else? But likely it's the World Chess Championship. So answer: Magnus Carlsen.

We can also mention that it was held in 2015, Carlsen defended his title. So answer: Magnus Carlsen.
